attributes.name: [Vercel OTel] Server-side error rate 99% rolling 30 days
attributes.description: Tracks the proportion of production lambda and edge requests that complete without an HTTP 5xx response, targeting 99% success over a rolling 30-day window. A breach signals that a serverless function or edge middleware defect is causing real requests to fail, degrading the core request-serving experience for end users. Requests where the function crashed before returning any response (http.response.status_code = -1) are excluded from both good and total counts, since no HTTP response was actually served.

params.filter: data_stream.dataset: "vercel.logs.otel" and vercel.log.source: ("lambda" or "edge") and deployment.environment.name: "production" and http.response.status_code >= 0
